dmp.description:
This document is an initial version of the Data Management Plan (DMP) for the research study (2023-2026) which has been conducted within the State research programme’s “Education” project No. VPP-IZM-Izglītība-2023/4-0001 “Elaboration of evidence-based solutions for effective professional competence development of adults and assessment of the transfer of its results into practice in Latvia”. The DMP will be implemented as a live document managed using the Argos DMP tool and important updates over the project lifetime will be uploaded on Zenodo. The DMP will be updated in time with the periodic evaluation of the project or more frequently if needed. The goal of the project is to elaborate an evidence-based framework and practical solutions for efficient and effective adults’ professional development and the transfer of its results into practice, offering tools for assessing the impact of professional development on practice at organisational and system levels in Latvia. The study is planned to be organised as a mixed-method design-based research. The purpose of data generation and collection in the project is to obtain quantitative and qualitative data to reach project’s objectives. The data generation and collection will comply with the EU ethics and legal requirements as well as national ethics and legal requirements. The research project will collect and generate the following types of data: 
  1. videorecords, transcripts and codes of focus-group discussions with representatives of main adult education and professional development service providers, adult learners from various working fields/branches as well as representatives of NGOs, enterprises and education policy institutions at national and local level (dataset 1); 
  2. survey data based on online and/or face-to-face questionnaires of adult learners to assess the current situation in the implementation of adults’ professional competence development and its transfer to practice in Latvia, identifying, for example, the motivations, behaviours, habits and opportunities of adults in choosing professional competence development (dataset 2).
dmp.ethical_issues_description: The personal data / sensitive information obtained during the videorecording (including participants names and physical presence) will not be shared.

project.description: The goal of the project is to elaborate an evidence-based framework and practical solutions for effective professional development of adults and the transfer of its results into practice, offering tools for assessing the impact of professional development on practice in Latvia. Implementing a design-based research approach, it is intended to carry out a systemic study of the transfer of professional competence development of adults into practice, its main obstacles and tools for measuring effectiveness, analysing theoretical knowledge and international experience in coherence of the context and needs of Latvia. The impact of the results of current professional competence development of adults on practice in Latvia will be analysed, considering the context of existing policy priorities and ongoing reforms. An evidence-based framework for effective professional competence development of adults and for the transfer of its results into practice will be developed, offering validated practical solutions for assessing the effectiveness of the professional development in organisational and system levels in accordance with the Latvian context and current educational policy goals. The results of the research will be presented in at least five international scientific conferences. It is envisaged that within the project three articles will be submitted or accepted for publication and three articles will be published in WoS or Scopus indexed journals and proceedings. It is planned that by the end of the project, two Master's theses will be defended. The results of the research will contribute to evidence-based decision-making on promoting the effectiveness of professional development of adults and the achievement of strategic education development objectives, as well as it will generate new knowledge and practical solutions at educational institution, local and national levels.
